title: wsblast baseline comparison (schema 1.2.x)
description: Output of `wsblast --compare BASELINE CURRENT --format json` (also written by `-o FILE`). Derived from `JsonComparison`, `Regression` and `Improvement` in src/report.rs. The baseline and current metrics themselves are not included. Readers must ignore properties they do not know. Schema 1.2 adds the time-series metrics (`series.*`) and `window`, and every 1.1 document is a valid 1.2 document. wsblast writes "1.2.0" when both reports have a time series or --compare-window is set, and otherwise "1.1.0", byte for byte the output of 0.2.0.

schema_version.description: Comparison schema version. wsblast 0.1.x and 0.2.0 write "1.1.0". wsblast 0.2.1 and later write "1.2.0" when the comparison includes the time-series metrics (both reports have a time series) or a --compare-window, and "1.1.0" otherwise.

threshold.description: The --compare-threshold value in percent (default 10). A metric is listed only when the absolute relative change is strictly greater than this value.

window.description: The --compare-window the time-series metrics were computed over, in seconds since each run started. Present only when --compare-window was set (schema 1.2). Whole-run metrics ignore it.

start_secs.description: Start of the window; 0 when the window was given as ..END.

end_secs.description: End of the window; absent when the window was given as START.. (open-ended).

regressions.description: Metrics that moved in the bad direction by more than the threshold, sorted by metric name. A non-empty list makes --fail-on-regression exit with code 2.

improvements.description: Metrics that moved in the good direction by more than the threshold, sorted by metric name.

metric.description: Compared metric. Higher is better for total_connections_established, total_messages_sent, total_messages_recv, total_bytes_sent, total_bytes_recv, throughput_msg_per_sec, throughput_bytes_per_sec and series.throughput_mean. Lower is better for total_connections_failed, error_rate, errors.<category> (one per error_breakdown key, such as errors.timeout), handshake_latency.{p50,p95,p99,p999}_us, message_rtt.{p50,p95,p99,p999}_us, response_time.{p50,p95,p99,p999}_us, series.throughput_cv, series.p99_median_us, series.p99_worst_us, series.error_intervals and series.max_interval_errors. response_time.* and series.* are compared only when both reports have the metric; series.* (schema 1.2) needs a time series in both reports and is defined in METHODOLOGY.md section 6.5. total_connections_attempted is never compared.

baseline.description: Value in the baseline report (0 when the metric is absent there, for example a new error category).

current.description: Value in the current report (0 when absent).

pct_change.description: Signed relative change in percent: (current - baseline) / baseline * 100. When the baseline is 0 and the current value is not, this is exactly 100.
